name: BingoCTF 2025
description: My first CTF competition I entered with Izz, Dhiyauddin, Ismail, Noor, Amirul. Hosted by Asia Pacific University.

name: HTB CTF Kuala Lumpur Open 2025
description: Won first and got myself 500 cubes and VIP access to HTB Academy.

name: RE:UN10N CTF 2025
description: With Dhiyauddin and Ismail, I have finished this 24 hour challenge.

name: Hack The Box MeetUp Malaysia UPM 2026
description: With my fellow friends, I have completed the CTF competition, also met a few people who I recognize from similar competitions.

name: Eschaton CTF 2026
description: Hosted by Muthoot Institute of Technology and Science, India. Learned a whole lot from this one.

name: Wireless Pentest 0day CTF 2026
description: Props to Shafiq Roslan for carrying our team. One of the few CTFs where I have completed all challenges.

name: 0xFUNCTF 2026
description: Intense 48 hour marathon. Probably the best CTF that I have ever played in.

name: Crackmes.one Rev Eng CTF 2026
description: This one focuses on reverse engineering and I heavily utilized Ghidra.

name: Batman Kitchen CTF 2026
description: A whole variety of challenges, hosted by University of Washington.

name: UniVsThreats (3rd Edition)
description: Having the space theme, this one opened my views on more CTFs.

name: EHAX CTF 2026
description: Another high competitive field CTF. A lot more flags captured.

name: CRYPTONITE 2026
description: Heavily focused on Web Exploitation and Steganography.

name: CodeVinci CTF 2026
description: Just another CTF, props to the CodeVinci team for server and ticket handling.

name: Dice CTF 2026
description: I faced the hardest teams in the world. This one is rated 100 on CTFtime, making it the hardest challenge ever.

name: Pro Labs Dante HTB Academy
description: I completed a real simulated hacking of a company named Dante. From one access point, we used multiple exploits to compromise the other machines and jump from one to another. By far the hardest challenge I've taken — capturing flags meant traversing the whole network, not tackling one challenge at a time.

name: PsychCTF 2026
description: Another CTF — I tackled OSINT mostly for this one, it was fun.

name: RITSEC CTF 2026
description: Pirate themed — we got doubloons instead of points. Another fun one.

name: DawgCTF 2026
description: Another smooth CTF event, looking forward for more.

name: Liga CTF 2026
description: Another one I tackled with Dhiyauddin and Ariff. 6 weeks of challenges. Once I was done with this, I took a long break from CTFs.

name: UMCS CTF 2026
description: With Dhiyauddin, Ariff, and Iqmal we solved a lot of challenges for this one. Shout out to Universiti Malaya.
